title: External Testing: stubserver Docker compose + fault injection (Plan 17 §12)
description:
Implement Plan 17 Section 12 — the standalone stubserver binary with Docker compose integration and fault injection test variants. Sections 1-11 are complete (cmd/stubserver/, internal/ai/testutil/stubserver/). This is the remaining gap from Partial signoff.

Key deliverables:
- Docker compose setup for stubserver
- Fault injection test variants
- Integration with existing stubserver code

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/17-external-testing.md §12

comments.author: Danny Cosson
comments.text: All §12 deliverables already implemented: Docker infrastructure (Dockerfile.stubserver, docker-compose.e2e.yaml, cmd/stubserver/main.go), fixtures (8 files in testdata/fixtures/), stubserver-backed Tier 1 tests (stubserver_test.go with multi-turn, auth, simple response), fault injection variants (F1-F4, F6, retry sequence), embedding stubserver tests (3 providers × 6 fault modes), and JSON fault server (stubserver_json.go). All 37 tier1 tests pass.
